objective: Compare exact-title Spain-facing Jackpot King RTP disclosures across licensed operators without assuming that a matching title or matching number establishes the same configuration or RTP decomposition.

regulatorySemantics.interpretation: The fair-payout page states that amounts assigned to jackpots are excluded from the calculations. Exact-title cross-operator controls nevertheless show both exact matches and systematic mismatches, including cases where bet365's theoretical value numerically equals Botemania base plus published jackpot/reserve funding components. Therefore this wording cannot be used by itself to relabel every bet365 theoretical value as the same ex-jackpot/base component shown by Botemania. Configuration and decomposition must be resolved per title.

matrixAssessment.interpretation: The Eye titles provide useful independent numeric corroboration for those exact displayed values, but Ted and Goonies are direct negative controls against any general same-title transfer rule. The Goonies equality between bet365 theoretical RTP and Botemania base+funding components is particularly important: it makes a universal ex-jackpot interpretation unsafe until the exact configuration/disclosure convention is fingerprinted.

scientificImplications: Exact-title matching across licensed Spanish operators is useful evidence but not configuration identity.
Two Eye of Horus JPK titles independently reproduce Botemania's published base numeric values, which is title-specific corroboration only.
Ted JPK differs slightly across operators, proving same title does not guarantee an identical theoretical return value.

The Goonies Return JPK bet365 theoretical value equals Botemania base plus its 0.38% jackpot and 0.11% reserve components, creating a decomposition ambiguity that forbids treating bet365 theoretical RTP as universally equivalent to Botemania base RTP.
The six monthly realized returns are operator-specific observations and cannot be transferred to Botemania or used as a future betting signal.
None of these comparisons identifies game-specific jackpot trigger frequency, Wheel King probability, tier probability or final jackpot hazard per EUR.
